definitions.explanation: a compensation structure where pay is based on a percentage of sales or performance rather than a fixed salary

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}は{歩合制|ぶあいせい}だ。
{歩合制|ぶあいせい}の{営業職|えいぎょうしょく}は{成績|せいせき}によって{収入|しゅうにゅう}が{変|か}わる。
examples.english: In commission-based sales positions, income varies depending on performance.

examples.japanese: {固定給|こていきゅう}と{歩合制|ぶあいせい}を{組|く}み{合|あ}わせた{給与|きゅうよ}{体系|たいけい}もある。
examples.english: Some compensation systems combine fixed salary with commission.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
- {歩合|ぶあい} (commission rate)
- {固定給|こていきゅう} (fixed salary)
- {出来高制|できだかせい} (piece-rate system)
- {成果報酬型|せいかほうしゅうがた} (performance-based compensation)
